Ivy (PM): Quick check-in: Acme wants model-level cache + optional HSM for pilot. Need a sequencing plan so we can commit to pilot date. Who owns order-of-ops?

Samir (Eng): Runtime owns routing + eviction logic. Estimate 2.5w dev + 3-4 days validation if we freeze scope (no batching). Blocker: KMS/HSM choice from infra.

Jonah (Runtime): We'll expose a feature-flag gate and a 10% canary. Canary = route -> quantized variant -> fallback on error. Need SRE automation for traffic shifts + KV warmup signals.

Priya (Infra): Hosted KMS + customer CMK: ~2-3 business days. Customer HSM: ~4w (contract + provisioning). VPC peering for on-prem adds ~3 days. Need Acme decision.

Eli (Security): I'll run a quick threat model. If keys must stay on-customer, we need HSM. Otherwise hosted CMK with strict access logs is acceptable for pilot. Ask Acme for preference now.

Nina (SRE): We'll take the canary. Need runbook entries: "rollback if P95 > 200ms or error rate >1% over 5m". Also want KV metrics (hit %, eviction rate).

Ivy (PM): Plan: 1) runtime PR + canary (Samir/Jonah), 2) infra KMS config (Priya), 3) security signoff (Eli), 4) SRE runbook and monitor (Nina). If Acme accepts hosted KMS, target pilot in ~5w. If HSM required, ~9w.

Samir (Eng): I'll scope a minimal PR: routing + eviction + smoke tests. CI job: `/deploy canary --percent 10 --model model-v2` to validate fallback.

Jonah (Runtime): Ticket ROUTE-900 created. PR target: Thu EOD.

Ivy (PM): Action items: Ivy confirm HSM preference (24h), Samir/Jonah deliver PR plan, Priya confirm provisioning times, Eli produce checklist, Nina draft runbook. Sync Friday 10am. :thumbsup:
